name: The Ninth Stair
summary: Sera wants to stand in the village she purged on Ashfound orders.

start.summary: Find the Ninth Stair. Sera says it lies somewhere in the Undercity Shards.

seen.summary: You found the village. Sera is standing in it.

done.summary: Sera stood in the Ninth Stair. She wants the roll of names next.

done_alone.summary: You found the Ninth Stair without Sera. The purge-mark is noted.

done_posthumous.summary: Sera died before she could see it. You carried the names out for her.
